info.title: Tomato Leaf Disease Severity Dataset
info.description:
This dataset contains tomato leaf images categorized by disease type and severity level. It is designed for disease classification and severity assessment tasks in plant pathology and agricultural machine learning research.

The dataset includes the following disease classes:

Bacterial_spot
Early_blight
Late_blight
Leaf_Mold
Septoria_leaf_spot
Healthy

For the severity dataset, disease samples are further categorized into three severity levels:

Early
Mid
Late

Severity labels are provided for all disease classes except Healthy. The Healthy class is included only in the disease classification dataset and does not contain severity annotations.

This dataset can be used for:
- Multi-class tomato disease classification
- Disease severity prediction
- Computer vision research in precision agriculture
- Deep learning model training and evaluation
